verdict.rationale: Statsig documents official Client and Server SDKs, including a JavaScript SDK, a React StatsigProvider quickstart, and On-Device Eval SDKs. The docs cover local evaluation, caching, retries and networking, and steer users toward SDKs over the raw HTTP API. Community users report implementing Statsig at multiple companies. missing for 10: an explicit enumeration of supported languages and platforms, and independent hands-on corroboration specific to SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: After initialization, both Client and Server SDKs evaluate experiments/gates _without a network request_, and typically in less than 1ms.
Abstract the complexity: Statsig handles caching, retry mechanisms, and networking.
Only use this HTTP API directly if no SDK exists for your language or if you have a specific use case that requires direct API access.
Update your app's default function (typically App.tsx or Layout.tsx) so that the StatsigProvider component identifier wraps all child components.
Many customers deploy both Server and Client SDKs, which lets them gate features on both the client and server side.
